subject: the Compressor Knee Controls row through the verified read-only parameter path
question: On the protected fixture, does the exact candidate read Knee from its named Controls row, preserve the raw and display values separately, restore the view and close its newly opened editor without calling a setter?

reverify.expected: exits 0 and writes a receipt whose checks are all true: State A returns separate raw and verbatim display values with write_attempted false, the view restore and new-editor close are observed, before and after inventories identify the same target, and stdin close removes the server process
reverify.cost: about thirty seconds on the protected fixture with stopped playback

method: Built debug product LogicProMCP at candidate 4fa4055d6f9f09a4ffc66f93d8344cbf0cd61f58 (tree 2b87d326b6e5406729ae05305e9ea91907349d7e; binary SHA-256 257a0d1ff17a4bb36633c8d226c1e95b405c1854312a3f3b9ef10c9cd9ca3060). Before driving it, native UI automation found one protected project window, stopped playback, Audio 13 selected, the Mixer visible, and no open menu or plug-in editor. The stdio client used only the read-only precondition sequence in the evidence. The issued insert reference identified Audio 13, Mixer strip 12, insert 1 as the Compressor. After the scalar read, the same inventory was read again, the server exited from stdin close, and a second independent UI snapshot checked window and transient-UI cleanup. No setter, save, project close, key input or click input was used.

observations.what: independent native UI readback after the server stopped

conclusion: The exact candidate read the named Knee row in State A with raw 7 and verbatim display 0.7, called no setter, observed the view restoration and new-editor close, and left the same complete target inventory before and after.
limits: One protected fixture, one Compressor instance, one host, and ko-KR only.
This read-only observation establishes neither Knee actuation nor a raw-to-normalized conversion, range, idempotent write, inverse, or cross-model availability.

The measured binary was built before this evidence-only record was added. The evidence commit changes no product or test source bytes, so the recorded binary continues to identify the product implementation under test.
